mapper.select: select a.*, (SELECT b.guoku_dscr FROM dmcode.cm_guoku_dimnsn b WHERE b.guoku_id = a.guoku_id) AS guokuDscr, string_agg(c.id::text, ',') AS roleId, string_agg(c.role_name, ',') AS roleName FROM "jeecg-boot-os".sys_user a JOIN "jeecg-boot-os".sys_user_role b ON a.id = b.user_id JOIN "jeecg-boot-os".sys_role c ON b.role_id = c.id where a.username = #{username} and a.del_flag = '0' GROUP BY a.id

SELECT a.id ,username ,realname, salt, avatar, CASE WHEN sex = '2' THEN '2' ELSE '1' END AS sex, CASE WHEN sex = '1' THEN '男' ELSE '女' END AS sex_dictText, email, phone, org_code, guoku_id AS guokuid, (SELECT b.guoku_dscr FROM dmcode.cm_guoku_dimnsn b WHERE b.guoku_id = a.guoku_id) AS "guokuDscr", (SELECT string_agg(b.guoku_dscr, ',') FROM dmcode.cm_guoku_dimnsn b WHERE guoku_id IN (SELECT guoku_id FROM "jeecg-boot-os".t_sc_user_guoku_relation WHERE login_id = a.id)) AS "viewableGuokuDscr", (SELECT string_agg(guoku_id::text, ',') FROM "jeecg-boot-os".t_sc_user_guoku_relation WHERE login_id = a.id) AS viewableguoku, CASE WHEN STATUS = '1' THEN '正常' ELSE '解冻' END AS status_dictText, STATUS AS "STATUS", del_flag, CASE WHEN activiti_sync = '1' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END AS "activitiSync", CASE WHEN activiti_sync = '1' THEN '同步' ELSE '不同步' END AS activiti_sync_dictText, COALESCE(TO_CHAR(a.birthday, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), '') AS birthday, string_agg(c.id::text, '，') AS "roleId", string_agg(c.role_name, '，') AS "roleName" FROM "jeecg-boot-os".sys_user a LEFT JOIN "jeecg-boot-os".sys_user_role b ON a.id = b.user_id LEFT JOIN "jeecg-boot-os".sys_role c ON b.role_id = c.id WHERE del_flag = '0'
AND a.username like '%${params.username}%'

AND email like '%${params.email}%'
AND a.status = '${params.status}'
AND phone like '%${params.phone}%'
GROUP BY a.id ORDER BY a.update_time DESC LIMIT ${params.rows} OFFSET ${params.page}
